title: Adding a setup-context response field: files that must change together
answers: I added a field to the experiment setup context response, what else must I update?
Where do I add a new field to target_surface in the experiments setup context?
Which generated files change when ExperimentSetupTargetSurfaceSerializer changes?
body:
A new field on the setup context response touches:
- products/experiments/backend/setup_context.py: dataclass (e.g. TargetSurface) and its _compute_* builder, plus the cache key version bump in _cache_key.
- products/experiments/backend/presentation/serializers.py: ExperimentSetupTargetSurfaceSerializer (with help_text, which flows into generated types).
- Generated: products/experiments/frontend/generated/api.schemas.ts and services/mcp/src/api/generated.ts (regenerate, don't hand-edit).
- products/experiments/frontend/setupInspector/SetupInspector.stories.tsx: FULL_CONTEXT fixture must include the new required field or types break.
- Tests in products/experiments/backend/test/test_setup_context.py.
- The agent skill (products/experiments/skills/creating-experiments/references/setup-decisions.md) if agents should read the field; TestCreationSkillNamesRealFields checks skill-referenced field names exist.
applies: experiments setup context endpoint response changes
